additional_context: Device is active in source/fhir.ini, and source/device/valueset-device-relationtype.xml includes the device-relationtype CodeSystem where the gateway concept is defined. Later related decisions changed the surrounding model: FHIR-36828 replaced Device.link with Device.gateway, FHIR-36830 corrected DeviceDefinition relation terminology, and FHIR-37614 refined Device.gateway and Observation.gatewayDevice guidance; all three already have reconcile commits on the combined branch.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit because the authoritative current Device relation CodeSystem already carries the FHIR-34311 wording. Adding redundant ValueSet prose or reviving Device.link text would not improve the current specification and could conflict with later Device gateway history.
